title: Celeriac and Cucumber Schnitzel Wrap
description: A light and crispy German-inspired schnitzel wrap featuring celeriac, cucumber, and a hint of bitterness from the bitter greens.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Dredge the celeriac slices in a mixture of flour and salt.
Add the celeriac to the pan and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, toast the wrap in the pan for a few seconds on each side.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the toasted wrap with the cooked celeriac, cucumber, and bitter greens.
